qualification_policy: Separate IDs/evidence for diagnostics and qualifications; no such runs count toward the proposed 60 experimental attempts.
why_needed: W4 gate requires the workload to run at N=1 replica(s), which is a different deployment from B0 and every other W cell; no existing evidence covers it.
vu_headroom_note: The pool is rate-derived. At 25/s: 25 x 5000 ms = 125 worst-case in-flight, plus 10% headroom, rounded to 150 VUs. That is exactly the B0 value, so this cell stays pool-identical to B0.

runs.gate: W4: N=1 replica (the workload axis) at 25/s for 300/600 s
runs.invalid_if: dropped_iterations > 0 (VU pool binds) or identity/capture mismatch
